lesson: A specialist view can recover relation capability without mutating a ratified shared representation.
process_rule: When joint adaptation improves a new capability but regresses an already-ratified capability, test multi-view specialization before choosing between freezing and destructive shared-weight adaptation.

lesson: More parameters did not materially improve the specialist on the original relation dev set.
process_rule: Do not scale raw capacity when a larger architecture is capability-tied; investigate objective/data/architecture semantics first.

lesson: Dropping a graph edge is not a valid universal dependency test when node text redundantly encodes the same relation semantics.
process_rule: Counterfactual evaluation must isolate the causal variable under test. Use same-text same-query relation-only pairs when measuring whether a graph model actually depends on graph structure.

lesson: A relation-essential paired challenge can distinguish genuine graph reasoning from semantic shortcutting.
process_rule: Freeze evaluation pairs, prohibit training on them, and if repair is needed generate independent analogues rather than contaminating the challenge.
